label: SA1 scenario inputs
value: 3 days downtime, 20% inventory loss, ₹4 L extra expense, ₹3 L cleanup

label: BI basis
value: SA1 uses revenue ₹10 L/day (§62); other scenarios use contribution = revenue × margin (A 30% → ₹3 L/day)
rationale: §43.1 BI ₹2.7 Cr over 90 d implies ₹3 L/day

label: Max-exposure BI horizon
value: 90 days

label: Extra expense max exposure
value: ₹50 L per facility
rationale: §43.1 extra expense / recovery row; B mirrors A

label: Hazard intensity H
value: 0–1 normalised band per hazard
rationale: Prototype proxy, not a return period

label: Vulnerability weights
value: High 1.0, Medium/High 0.75, Medium 0.5

label: Risk bands
value: Rnorm ≥ 0.35 High; ≥ 0.10 Medium; else Low (Rnorm = R ÷ 5)
rationale: Kit calibration so the §26 flood exposure reads High

label: Mitigation effectiveness
value: Per-action 0–1; combined M = 1 − Π(1 − e) over verified mitigations, capped 0.9

label: Supply-chain consequence
value: max(0, interruption − max(buffer, downtime)) × contribution/day × dependency share (A 0.6, B 0.8)
rationale: Counts only days beyond facility downtime and stock buffer

label: Accessibility weights
value: Coverage 20, reliability 25, speed 25, redundancy 15, capability 10; normalised by available weight

label: Accessibility bounds
value: Speed scale 8–30 min; coverage needs P50 ≤ 20 min

label: Percentile sample rules
value: P50 n ≥ 3, P90 n ≥ 6, P95 n ≥ 10; linear interpolation; sample factor n ÷ (n + 5)

label: Priority factor mapping
value: Impact and feasibility 1–5 from §74.2 labels; likelihood from current hazard band (High 5, Medium 3, Low 1) or 3 for supply and insurance; urgency from days to due date

label: Verification confidence
value: Self-attested 0.40, document 0.60, photo 0.60, remote expert 0.80, physical 0.95, outcome 0.98

label: Preparedness factors
value: Verified 1.0, implemented 0.6, drift detected 0.4, other states 0

label: SA2 cyclone inputs
value: Building damage 5%, stock 10%, 7 days downtime, ₹5 L extra, ₹8 L recovery, 14-day supplier block

label: SA3 grid outage inputs
value: 72 h outage − 12 h fuel = 2.5 days; ₹2 L diesel tanker; 14-day supplier block; verified DG test caps downtime at 1 day

label: SB1 release inputs
value: Tank damage 30%, monomer loss 50%, 60-day closure, ₹25 L response, ₹40 L decontamination
rationale: Kit-derived from §35.5 and §70; no dossier figures

label: SB2 cyclone inputs
value: Building 4%, polymer stock 15%, 5 days downtime, ₹6 L extra, ₹10 L recovery, 10-day port closure

label: SB3 fire inputs
value: Building 10%, reactor 15%, monomer 20%, 21 days downtime, ₹10 L extra, ₹30 L recovery

label: Cascade edge weights
value: Conditional likelihood 0–1 per edge; chain score = product

label: Monitoring thresholds
value: A: rain 100/200 mm, wind 62/118 km/h. B: tank 20/24 °C, vapour 10/25/50 ppm, wind 62/118 km/h

label: Polymer plant archetype
value: Assets, financials, inventory, community population and policy are kit-derived
rationale: Dossier gives no worked numbers for this archetype

label: Replay signals and outcomes
value: All signal values, times of day and observed outcomes are illustrative

label: Checklist scoring
value: Pass 1, partial 0.5, fail 0 over 17 Appendix A domains

label: Policy schedules
value: A limits from §43.1 'current protection'; deductibles, sublimits, time excess and exclusions are kit-derived
rationale: Shows how terms change usable protection (§43)

label: Provenance scoring
value: Weights freshness 0.25, completeness 0.25, spatial 0.20, temporal 0.15, consistency 0.15 × authority factor (official 1, partner 0.9, open 0.85, customer 0.8, estimated 0.6); uncertain licence gates to 0
